func ast_join_strings(vec: std.Vector[str, ctx], sep: str, ctx: &Arena) str {
    mut result := "";
    mut i := 0;
    while i < len(vec) {
        if i > 0 {
            result = std.Concat(result, sep);
        }
        result = std.Concat(result, vec[i]);
        i = i + 1;
    }
    return std.Clone(ctx, result);
}
